verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that lets external agents such as Claude, Cursor and Copilot query metrics, logs, traces and alerts. It also offers service accounts for programmatic API access by external integrations, and documents debugging use cases such as reconstructing a bug from a trace ID. missing for 10: a published API reference or OpenAPI spec for the query endpoints (the OpenAPI probe returned 404 at all candidate paths), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents debugging production through these interfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an external agent query metrics, logs, and traces through documented APIs to debug production

citations.quote: Connect Claude, Cursor, Copilot, and other AI agents to SigNoz via MCP for natural language access to metrics, logs, traces, and alerts.
Query metrics, traces, logs, alerts, and dashboards through natural language.
Service accounts provide a secure way to grant programmatic API access to SigNoz without tying credentials to individual users.
generate queries over traces, logs, and metrics, write ClickHouse queries
